notes: IF = 20 mA per colour channel (datasheet p.3). That table is an embedded image and does not survive pdftotext; it was read with a vision pass on a rendered page.
Full white = 3 x 20 mA = 60 mA per LED. A 6x6 module is 36 x 60 mA = 2.16 A at 5 V, which is 8% above the XL1509's 2 A rating.
VDD absolute maximum 5.3 V (datasheet p.2), supply range 3.5-5.3 V. An XL1509-5.0 outputs 4.8-5.2 V, leaving as little as 0.1 V of headroom at the top of tolerance.
Drive is internally constant-current, so the LEDs do not need external current limiting and are not themselves at risk from an overcurrent event.
Pinout (datasheet p.2): 1 = DOUT, 2 = VDD, 3 = GND, 4 = DIN.
